title: Nano Nuclear Energy Bring Microreactors to UAE
summary: US microreactor company Nano Nuclear Energy is on the path to deploy its technology to the Middle East after signing the first and only nuclear microreactor partnership with the UAE. The agreement aims to help the country go off grid, power desert data centers and decarbonize oil and gas fields. Jay Yu, the company's founder, executive chairman and president spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa on the deployment in the UAE plus their plans for Mideast expansion. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Natural Gas Eclipses Oil as Key Inflation Risk for European Debt

title: Zimbabwe’s Economic Turnaround Breaks With the Past
summary: Citigroup suggests the Southern African nation may be on a path to breaking from its past of economic instability, under the International Monetary Fund's watch. Bloomberg Television's Jennifer Zabasajja explains on "Horizons Middle East and Africa."  (Source: Bloomberg)
